instruction: Fix net.retry.retry. Its contract: call fn() at most max_attempts times IN TOTAL (the first call counts as an attempt), sleep between attempts using net.backoff.delay_s, re-raise the last TransientError once the attempts are used up, and never retry a PermanentError (re-raise it immediately). net.client.Client depends on this. Run the tests in tests/; do not edit the tests.
